ATSB_envelope.basis: ATSB 2017 (Operational Search, pp.95-96, Fig.73): combined 97.4% high-confidence coverage (>95% detection), 2.1% lower-POD (50-90%, nominal 70%), 0.5% gaps (0%). Mid = 0.974*0.975+0.021*0.7 = 0.96. Low additionally x0.9 for imagery-review / classification misses and holidays not captured by the 100 m metric; high = HC 100%, LC 90%. Applied only where no Fig.73 area polygon applies.

ATSB_area.basis: Per Fig.73 area: mid = HC*0.975 + LC*0.7; high = HC*1.0 + LC*0.9; low = (HC*0.95 + LC*0.5)*0.9 (extra x0.9 review/classification factor).

ATSB_gap.basis: Interior hole in the public GA sonar mosaics (no imagery) - ATSB rates data holidays at 0% detection.

HPSA_gap.basis: Iannello (radiantphysics, 11 Feb 2023): ~30.5 km2 around 34.53S 93.84E 'never scanned' (steep slope missed by GO Phoenix, half-scanned by OI 2018). ATSB d=0.

GoPhoenix_gap.basis: CAPTION KMZ: gap in GO Phoenix SAS coverage near the HPSA (55 km2). ATSB d=0 (high bound 0.5: deep-tow / AUV may have covered parts). OI 2018 coverage there is applied from the OI 2018 polygons where they overlap.

OI2018_site.basis: OI 2018 Hugin AUVs (side-scan + MBES), 'high quality data in which we have full confidence' (OI 30 Apr 2018); OI reportedly estimated ~99% coverage (Godfrey, 28 May 2018, unofficial); a second-hand 3.1% data-holiday figure exists. No official POD was published; Broken Ridge terrain is difficult. Best 0.92, low 0.80, high 0.98.

OI2018_intra_junction.basis: Gaps < ~3 km between adjacent digitised OI 2018 sites (e.g. Site 1/2 at 32.4S). The official maps show the sites abutting, so best/high treat them as covered with the site POD; the low bound treats them as real gaps.

ATSB_OI_junction_sliver.basis: Slivers < ~3 km wide between the ATSB coverage edge (0.5 km accurate) and the digitised OI 2018 site edges (+/-1-2 km), mostly along the Site-1 legs at 34.7-36S. Could be digitising error (then covered, 0.92) or real unsearched slivers (0): best = 0.5 x 0.92.

OI2018_site4_remainder.basis: Planned Site-4 box NE of the 27 May coverage; completion ~27-30 May inferred from the AIS track, not from an official map.

OI2018_north_inferred.basis: 30 May-7 Jun 2018 sweep to ~25S, no official map; 'gaps between AUV tracks opened out again' (R. Cole, AirlineRatings 31 May 2018); AUVs recovered early, one AUV swath 5.2 km vs 7.4 km (Godfrey). Geometry inferred from AIS; the CAPTION community outline independently reaches 24.73S.

OI2025_post_contract.basis: Hugin AUVs (Armada 78 06 / 86 05). Official tally 7,571 km2, no map; footprint ASSUMED from AIS tracks + tally (+/-8 km). No POD published.

OI2025_pre_contract_SW.basis: Pre-signing survey 11-24 Mar 2025 inferred only from the AIS envelope; OI never published its extent or area; AUV coverage within the envelope may be partial.

OI2025_infill_HPSA.basis: Feb 2025 pre-contract infill reportedly targeted earlier gaps incl. the HPSA (Iannello); which patches were filled is unknown.

Bluefin21.basis: Bluefin-21 AUV side-scan, Apr-May 2014, ~860 km2 around the Ocean Shield acoustic detections (GA feature service polygon). ATSB: no aircraft debris found. Lies ~5 km from the sea-level 7th arc at 21.1S, so it is arc coverage.
